info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Banking Accounts Verify-v2-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Verification API facilitates the validation of banking account details to ensure accuracy before activation. This endpoint allows businesses to verify user-submitted banking information, reducing the risk of fraud and processing errors. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers that require reliable banking verification as part of their onboarding process. With this API, organizations can improve customer experience and enhance security measures during account setups.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to verify their accounts by providing the necessary verification details. Successful verification enhances the security and integrity of user accounts.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the necessary information to verify an account. It includes the credentials and any additional data required for the verification process.

200.description: Verification successful, the request has been processed.
